```{r message=FALSE}
here::i_am("extensions/event_study.Rmd")
reg_final_path <- here::here("replication", "output", "regression_data_final.rds")
reg_final <- readRDS(reg_final_path)
```

```{r}
# Event-study regression with 2017 as reference year
models_event_tech_pharma <- list()
models_event_tech_pharma$fa <- fixest::feols(
  fa_ratio ~
    i(year, tech_dummy, ref = 2017) +
    i(year, pharma_dummy, ref = 2017) |
    gvkey + year,
  data = reg_final,
  vcov = ~gvkey
)
models_event_tech_pharma$cash <- fixest::feols(
  cash_ratio ~
    i(year, tech_dummy, ref = 2017) +
    i(year, pharma_dummy, ref = 2017) |
    gvkey + year,
  data = reg_final,
  vcov = ~gvkey
)
models_event_tech_pharma$mkt <- fixest::feols(
  mkt_ratio ~
    i(year, tech_dummy, ref = 2017) +
    i(year, pharma_dummy, ref = 2017) |
    gvkey + year,
  data = reg_final,
  vcov = ~gvkey
)
fixest::etable(models_event_tech_pharma, vcov = list("each",'iid', ~gvkey))
```

```{r}
# Plot dynamic effects
fixest::iplot(
  models_event_tech_pharma$fa,
  sep = 0,
  ref.line = 0,
  main = "Event Study: Financial Assets",
  xlab = "Year",
  ylab = "Effect relative to 2017 (pp)"
)
```

```{r}
fixest::iplot(
  models_event_tech_pharma$cash,
  sep = 0,
  ref.line = 0,
  main = "Event Study: Cash-like Assets",
  xlab = "Year",
  ylab = "Effect relative to 2017 (pp)"
)
```

```{r}
# Plot dynamic effects
fixest::iplot(
  models_event_tech_pharma$mkt,

  ref.line = 0,
  main = "Event Study: Marketable Assets",

  ylab = "Effect relative to 2017 (pp)"
)
```
